edit.description: a describe for bin/flume.js beside the POSIX symlink-walk cases

summary: Pin bin/flume.js — the published bin.flume entry — to the three properties spec/cli.md Distribution declares of it

per.section: Narration is the ladder's bottom rung

pins: bin/flume.js execs dist/cli.js with argv preserved
bin/flume.js propagates the child's non-zero exit status
bin/flume.js re-raises the child's terminating signal
acceptance: tests/bin.test.ts drives bin/flume.js directly over a fake dist/cli.js; all three pins green in the default lane
notes: bin/flume.js is package.json bin.flume — the only entry a consumer invokes — and carries zero suite coverage; its unpublished POSIX sibling carries two. smoke-install asserts exit 0 on success paths only, off a full pack+install. `pnpm test` also runs on windows-latest: the signal pin wants a win32 skip (a child self-killing with SIGTERM there yields a status, not a signal).
